arguments.content: Open thread for future retrieval: if the transdermal CBD collaboration reopens, ask whether existing PK summaries or archived samples can support a route-of-metabolism fingerprint. The core analytes are parent CBD, 7-OH-CBD, and 7-COOH-CBD, with metabolite-to-parent ratios compared against oral benchmarks. Keep patient register; deploy only if the collaborator asks for objectives or next steps.
